Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：喜欢在墓地里玩，装作祭拜，Place phrases normally come before the action verb, and 装作 must be followed by the action someone is pretending to do. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟妈妈：孟母带着他，The original wording presents Mengzi as simply accompanying his mother. To describe the mother moving Mengzi, make the mother the subject and use 带着. [vocab list]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Mengzi was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no competing male character intervenes, so a pronoun is more natural for a close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子五岁的时候：他五岁的时候，Use a pronoun for Mengzi because he remains the clear referent from the previous sentence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 妈妈认为：她认为，The mother was mentioned in the preceding sentence, so a pronoun is natural for this close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬家：搬了家，This is a completed moving event at age five, so the action needs 了; with a separable verb, place it after the verb-object combination. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在“玩”前，“装祭拜”也需要改成正确的“装作祭拜”结构。
“孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家”本身可以表示孟子和妈妈一起搬家，并无错误。
孟子刚在前句出现且指代明确，按该标准近距离再次提及应使用“他”。
前文刚提到孟子且没有其他可竞争的男性人物，此处应使用“他”。
妈妈在前句刚出现，近距离重复指称时应改用“她”。
这里叙述五岁时已经完成的一次搬家事件，应说“搬了家”。
